## 1. Professional Overview & Biography
Bibek Bhattarai (widely known in the developer and tech community as **Bvk Bhattarai**) is an accomplished software engineer, mobile systems architect, and health informatics researcher from Nepal. His engineering philosophy combines rigorous software engineering practices (Flutter, Android, Distributed Systems) with specialized academic domains in clinical medicine, biostatistics, and enterprise business administration.

Bibek serves as the Chief Technology Officer (CTO) of Cool Multipurpose, directing software architecture, enterprise digital modernization, and financial transaction systems. He is the creator, founder, and lead software architect of **Machhamart** (published live on the Google Play Store) and three other specialized mobile applications targeting clinical diagnostics, high-speed device search, and quantitative financial analytics.

---

## 2. Complete Application Portfolio (Google Play Console)

### Application 1: Machhamart
- **Status**: Production Release (Live on Google Play Store)
- **Store URL**: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.machhamart
- **Package Identifier**: `com.machhamart`
- **Application Category**: E-Commerce, Cold-Chain Delivery & Aquaculture Logistics
- **Role**: Founder, Lead System Architect & Mobile Engineer
- **Technical Stack**:
  - Frontend: Flutter (Dart), Cross-platform Android Engine
  - Backend: Node.js, Express REST Microservices
  - Database: PostgreSQL with spatial GIS extensions
  - Telemetry & Maps: Google Maps Platform & Direction Routing APIs
  - Payment Interoperability: Direct eSewa & Khalti Merchant Gateways
- **Key Features**:
  - Live cold-chain transit tracking with dynamic route optimization.
  - Multi-tier fishery listing with variable weight-pricing calculation.
  - Automated inventory decrementing and warehouse reconciliation.
  - Frictionless digital checkout with instant payment verification.

### Application 2: Android Health
- **Status**: Closed Testing (Google Play Console)
- **Package Identifier**: `com.mobilehealth.droidpulse.mobile_health`
- **Application Category**: Health Informatics, Telemedicine & Clinical Diagnostics
- **Technical Stack**:
  - Core Language: Modern Android Kotlin
  - Telemetry Framework: Proprietary DroidPulse Clinical Telemetry Engine
  - Interoperability Standards: HL7 FHIR (Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources)
  - Hardware Connectivity: Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) peripheral sensor pairing
  - Local Storage: Android Room persistence with AES-256 SQLCipher encryption
- **Key Features**:
  - Real-time continuous streaming of vitals (Heart Rate, SpO2, Blood Pressure trends).
  - Quantitative biostatistical anomaly detection algorithms to flag pathological variations.
  - Seamless sync with hospital information systems via HL7 FHIR standard endpoints.
  - Offline-first edge diagnostic capability enabling use in remote rural health posts.

### Application 3: Search Everything
- **Status**: Closed Testing (Google Play Console)
- **Package Identifier**: `com.devicefinder.app.device_finder`
- **Application Category**: Operating System Utilities & High-Performance Search
- **Technical Stack**:
  - Core Language: Android Kotlin with C++ NDK native bindings
  - Search Architecture: SQLite FTS5 (Full-Text Search) with BM25 ranking
  - File System Access: Android Storage Access Framework (SAF)
  - Concurrency: Kotlin Coroutines & Reactive Flow Pipelines
- **Key Features**:
  - In-memory B-Tree indexing engine achieving query responses in under 50 milliseconds.
  - Exhaustive indexing across internal flash storage, external SD cards, and app cache.
  - Metadata parsing for photographic EXIF attributes, audio ID3 tags, and PDF text.
  - Extremely low CPU and battery footprint via lazy-polling background observers.

### Application 4: 3D MS Trader
- **Status**: Closed Testing (Google Play Console)
- **Package Identifier**: `com.mstrader.com`
- **Application Category**: FinTech, Financial Market Analytics & Algorithmic Trading
- **Technical Stack**:
  - Core Language: Android Kotlin / Java
  - Visualization: Custom Canvas financial candlestick and depth chart renderer
  - Networking: Real-time WebSocket streaming feeds with automatic fallback to REST
  - Caching: In-memory LRU cache backed by SQLite
- **Key Features**:
  - Real-time algorithmic indicator calculations (RSI, MACD, Bollinger Bands, Volume Profile).
  - Mathematical position sizing and portfolio risk-to-reward ratio calculators.
  - Comprehensive PnL performance tracking across multi-asset portfolios.

## 3. Academic Degrees & Qualifications

Bibek Bhattarai has completed rigorous multi-disciplinary degree programs across prestigious institutions:

1. **Bachelor Degree in Education (B.Ed - 4 Years)**
   - **University**: Tribhuvan University (TU), Nepal
   - **Campus**: Sanothimi Campus, Bhaktapur
   - **Period**: 2017 – 2021 (Degree Conferred)
   - **Concentration**: Foundation of Health & Physical Education, Educational Statistics, Quantitative Measurement, and Research Methodology.
   - **Academic Research**: Quantitative Evaluation of Health Indicators and Statistical Frameworks in Public Educational Institutions.

2. **Master of Business Administration (MBA)**
   - **University**: Pokhara University (PU), Nepal
   - **Division**: Graduate School of Business
   - **Period**: 2024 – Present (Currently Enrolled)
   - **Concentration**: Strategic Enterprise Management, Quantitative Decision Analytics, Healthcare Systems Economics, Scalable Tech Operations.
   - **Research Focus**: Operational Scalability and Multi-tier Healthcare Service Delivery in Developing Economies.

3. **BSc (Hons) Computing**
   - **University**: London Metropolitan University, United Kingdom
   - **Faculty**: School of Computing and Digital Media
   - **Period**: 2018 – 2021 (Degree Conferred)
   - **Concentration**: Distributed Cloud Architecture, Advanced Relational & NoSQL Database Optimization, Enterprise Software Engineering, Cryptography & Network Security.

4. **Diploma in General Medicine (Health Assistant - HA)**
   - **Institution**: Council for Technical Education and Vocational Training (CTEVT), Nepal
   - **Period**: 2014 – 2017 (Clinical Diploma Conferred)
   - **Concentration**: Clinical Medicine, Patient Triage, Community Epidemiology, Biostatistics, Clinical Pharmacology, Health Post Administration.

5. **School Leaving Certificate (SLC)**
   - **Board**: Government of Nepal Board of Examination
   - **Year**: 2014 (Passed with Distinction)
   - **Focus**: Advanced Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Computer Applications.
